title: Eventual scalar image of punctured principal restriction
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of depth at least three [def-weil-pbc-depth], g in its maximal ideal, and W its punctured spectrum [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For the quotient map f:R to R/(g) and every n, there is a finite gap k such that every section on openThickening f W (n+k) [lem-sbc-finite-etale-adic-sections-transfer] restricts to the scalar image of R at level n. Restriction is the recursively composed k consecutive openThickeningTransition.appTop maps, with identity at k=0. The gap is independent of the section, and no compatible infinite family is assumed.

proof.text: Depth three implies depth two. Apply canonical depth-two Hartogs and GammaSpecIso to obtain surjectivity of the scalar restriction R->Gamma(W,O_W). Apply the depth-three puncture H^1 lemma to obtain the vanishing hypothesis needed by the lifting lemma.

The kernels of scalar multiplication by g^j form an increasing chain of R-submodules of R. Mathlib monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian makes the chain constant from c on. For j>=c use equality of kernels; for j<=c use monotonicity. Consequently g^c kills every element killed by any g^j. This is the private proved scalar_power_torsion_bound helper.

Apply principal_thickening_sections_lift to this c, the H^1 vanishing and the recursive puncturedPrincipalSectionRestriction (whose two recursion laws are reflexivity). Choose the same gap c at every n. Lift the resulting ambient section through Hartogs surjectivity, then use comp_appTop and associativity to identify the resulting scalar map with the exact map in the goal.

lean.statement:
theorem punctured_principal_eventual_scalar_image
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (g : R) (hg : g ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hdepth : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := R) R)
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hW : ∀ x : Spec (.of R), x ∈ W ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) :
    let f := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})
    ∀ n, ∃ k : ℕ,
      ∀ t : Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening f W (n + k), ⊤), ∃ a : R,
        ((ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫
          (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap f W n ≫ W.ι).appTop) a =
            puncturedPrincipalSectionRestriction f W n k t
